agenda may do so as follows:

home page of our city’s website at ci.carson.ca.us, up until the meeting’s

CH inquired if the project include MLK Avenue. Staff addressed his inquiry
AR noted his understanding there is a law that requires open space be maintained. He inquired where is the proposal for open space. Saied addressed his inquiry. 
Sunny Soltani offered additional information addressing the mayors inquiry. 

JD spoke about the benefits of the project
JH inquired about local hire - ensuring that residents are employed on this project. CA Soltani noted that because the city is not the lead agency, they have no control. However, staff can write a letter urging the BOS and Developer to consider Local Hire. 
JD accepted as a friendly amendment.
AR spoke about this disagreement with the open space clause

JD inquired about the bike path on page 22 of staff report. He noted the proposed route is problematic, citing that its steep and difficult for bikers to navigate. The Developer should be approached about an existing bridge that could be used to address the concern. He directed staff to address this concern with the developer.

18.. COVID-19 UPDATE (CITY COUNCIL)  -  Action: adopted (Pass) Moved by Jim Dear This item was heard after Item No. 22 - 
CM Landers gave a powerpoint presentation on COVID-19 Trends. 
AR inquired about the labor organizations discord with the telecommuting policy.  
Director Moseley addressed his question. 
LDH inquired about the specifics of an impasse.
CM Landers addressed her inquiry. 
CH inquired about the health and safety concerns come into play
CM Landers addressed his inquiry
Sunny Soltani noted she will research whether or not telecommuting can be mandated in the event there is a liability concern. 
Direction was provided for staff to bring back the status and options of the telecommuting policy. 
Raymond Cheung gave a powerpoint presentation on the State and LA County Health and Safer at Home Orders
